summary: Schema 017 is current. RC202 keeps email as the only local login identity, makes display names presentation-only, revokes prior sessions when invitations are accepted, hides human-only secret mutations from bearer capabilities, includes audited legacy-admin recovery, and carries fail-closed admission, public-provider egress, tunable infrastructure, read-only Argo observation, GitHub retry handling, historical source-build reads, and active immutable source visibility in the web UI.
